note: Java bridge: Spring WebFlux support. In a REACTIVE web application with WebFlux on the classpath, VesperaBridgeReactiveAutoConfiguration registers VesperaReactiveProxyHandler (non-blocking: dispatchAsync, client disconnect cancels the native dispatch, aggregated request body capped by max-buffered-request-bytes with 413, text/event-stream / NDJSON responses streamed via the header-first streaming symbol on boundedElastic), VesperaReactiveHandlerMapping (include/exclude patterns, after @Controllers and router functions), VesperaReactivePreflightFilter (cors=rust), ReactiveAppNameResolver (exposed-apps allowlist) and ReactivePrincipalResolver (exchange principal), all @ConditionalOnMissingBean. The servlet autoconfiguration stays SERVLET-only. WebFlux and Reactor are compileOnly: the published POM still declares no dependencies (enforced by verifyPublishedPom).
